data.value: During the first week of October 2012, will major national polling organizations publicly release at least three new head-to-head surveys on the Obama-Romney presidential race?

The 2012 U.S. presidential election is between Barack Obama (incumbent Democrat) and Mitt Romney (Republican). The first week of October 2012 is a period when polling organizations may release new surveys. The public release of a survey means it is made available via press release, website, or media partners.
